svg.text: Redrawn from Fender 'Champ-Amp Layout, Model 5C1' drawing (F-DH), page 2 of the same PDF as the schematic — board component order and wiring read directly from the published sheet — not a trace
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
